annotations.title: Check an input against its source

description: Garbage-in guard. Checks whether a piece of data is really vouched for by the domain it claims to come from (a sebbi Verified Source). Returns GENUINE, UNVERIFIED or UNKNOWN, sealed into Bitcoin. Call it before trusting an input.

hash.description: Or the SHA-256 of the data, instead of the text
